biggest_catch: The FTC sued Walmart in 2026 over Spark Driver pay — alleging drivers 'did not receive promised payments' — and Walmart agreed to a $100 million judgment.
catches: FTC (Feb 2026): Walmart agreed to a $100M judgment to settle FTC and state charges over deceptive earnings claims related to Spark Driver — the complaint sought relief for drivers who 'did not receive promised payments due to Walmart's conduct.'
Under the lane's documented-non-payment rule, an FTC-enforced non-payment case is a hard reject regardless of current pay claims.
No official Walmart/Spark payout-timing terms surfaced on Walmart's own domain (Branch weekly-Tuesday pay is third-party-reported).
Drivers may be placed on a zone waitlist before they can work at all.
